mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates indicate weak labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, which depress corporate earnings growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 850 thousand units signals weakening residential construction activity and reduced economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 850), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in industrial production below 99.0 index points indicates deteriorating manufacturing output and economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 99.0), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in retail sales (RSAFS < 400,000 million dollars) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.1%) signal a dual headwind of weak consumer demand and tight monetary policy, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS < 400,000 and FEDFUNDS > 0.1%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% month-over-month) combined with high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.1%) indicates a fragile labor market and restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.1%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates and reducing corporate borrowing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.5%), elevated joblessness suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
